mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (indicating an accommodative monetary policy stance) compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 6.5% indicates a weak labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with both INDPRO and HOUST declining, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-2008 recovery regime, a high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 6.5%) signals persistent labor market weakness, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:2014-03-15 is within post-2008 recovery period
failure_condition: In the post-2008 recovery regime, 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST > 850 thousand units) indicates robust consumer demand and economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 850, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below the 2017 base (INDPRO < 100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing and supply activity, which reduces corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 6.5%) signals an aggressive monetary policy response to a deteriorating labor market, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary policy response to labor weakness
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with both FEDFUNDS declining and UNRATE > 6.5%, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In the high consumer spending regime (RSAFS > 420,000 million dollars), a high level of retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In the high consumer spending regime, 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when RSAFS > 420,000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
